description: Look up a human gene by symbol in Ensembl, e.g. query "BRCA2": Ensembl ID, description, biotype and GRCh38 location. Gene symbols are case- and digit-sensitive — pass the symbol exactly. Source: Ensembl (EMBL-EBI), CC0. License: CC0 (Ensembl, EMBL-EBI).

query.description: Search term for this source (see the tool description for what it expects).
